noun_definition: Chat refers to a feature within the App that allows users to communicate and interact with others, specifically through a messaging interface where user suggestions can be accessed by typing "@" during a conversation.
Tab refers to the interface element that displays a list of user suggestions when the user types "@" in a chat.
List refers to the collection of user suggestions that appears when the user types "@" in the chat.
User suggestions refer to the list of potential user names that appears when typing "@" in a chat within the app.
Delay refers to the lag in time before the tab with the list of user suggestions appears after the user types "@" in the chat.
empty refers to the state of the tab with the list of user suggestions when it fails to display any content after being opened.
Partially displayed refers to the incomplete rendering of the tab containing user suggestions, which fails to show all expected content when opened.
